analytics.title: Lead dashboard
analytics.subtitle: Total tasks, total interventions, intervention rate, trust health, plus the trend, the parameters people keep editing and the rankings. Every number is recomputed from the records; what cannot be computed stays an honest zero.
analytics.empty: Nothing to show yet: this range has no records, or this read has not come back.
analytics.metric.trust.hint: = 1 minus the intervention rate (the number the server sent)
analytics.metric.trust.derived: The server did not send this metric: this sketch is the page computing 1 minus the rate, not the server's number
analytics.metric.users.hint: Counts only people who actually decided; user ids are anonymised
analytics.chart.title: Intervention rate trend
analytics.chart.empty: No trend point in this range: there are no records in it.
analytics.chart.aria: Intervention rate line, {points} buckets, peak {max}, low {min}
analytics.heat.title: Parameter edit heatmap
analytics.heat.empty: No record edited a parameter: the heatmap is empty, that is not a load failure.
analytics.top.title: Rankings
analytics.plane.title: Data plane: where these numbers come from
analytics.plane.pre: Pre-aggregated read: the numbers come from the merged rows of the append-only ledger agg_daily.jsonl.
analytics.plane.stream: Not pre-aggregated: this set of numbers was computed by walking the records line by line just now.
analytics.plane.unknown: The server sent no provenance note: the page cannot tell whether the ledger answered or a line-by-line scan did.
analytics.plane.slow: Not pre-aggregated, this read is slow: measured {ms} ms. The three-second promise only holds on a pre-aggregated read.
analytics.plane.slow_hit: Pre-aggregated, and this read still measured {ms} ms: the cost sits on the disk and ledger side, not in the aggregation rules.
analytics.plane.scanned: This read walked {count} records line by line (O(1) memory, nothing loaded whole).
analytics.plane.timing.pre: Pre-aggregated read: the three-second promise applies to this one, and the measured value sits right above.
analytics.plane.timing.stream: Not pre-aggregated: there is no three-second promise to make for this read, the numbers came from a line-by-line scan.
analytics.plane.reason.no_ledger_wired: Reason code no_ledger_wired: this server instance has no pre-aggregation ledger wired, so it can only scan.
analytics.plane.reason.agent_filter: Reason code agent_filter: an agent filter walks the records line by line, because ledger rows aggregate by day and tool and carry no agent dimension.
analytics.plane.reason.custom_salt: Reason code custom_salt: a custom anonymisation salt is set, which the ledger merge does not carry, so this read scans.
analytics.plane.reason.input_not_rerunnable: Reason code input_not_rerunnable: the record input is a one-shot iterator that cannot be re-scanned.
analytics.plane.reason.ledger_missing_no_records: Reason code ledger_missing_no_records: there is no ledger yet and nothing to aggregate, so this read honestly scans.
analytics.plane.reason.ledger_unreadable: Reason code ledger_unreadable: the ledger could not be read (permission or file trouble), so this read honestly scanned instead.
analytics.plane.reason.chain_tampered: Reason code chain_tampered: the ledger hash chain did not verify, so this read scanned and the problem list travels with the metadata.
analytics.plane.problems: {count} ledger rows could not be read; the reason codes travel with the metadata, the page does not translate a guess.
analytics.plane.head: Ledger chain head: {head}
analytics.plane.not_durable: The ledger write did not land: these numbers came from the in-memory recompute view, and the next call retries idempotently.
analytics.plane.generated: The server generated this read at {at}; the page does not compute metrics itself.
analytics.plane.refresh: There is no push channel: a refresh is a query moment (opening the panel, applying filters, pressing Query again), not a server push.
analytics.export.title: Export this dashboard
analytics.export.note: Two buttons, CSV and PDF; the format enum is frozen at csv|pdf (format=html is a server-side 400). When reportlab is missing the server ships printable HTML: the filename, the format header and the fallback reason always describe the bytes actually served, and the page never paints a degradation as a success.
analytics.export.busy: Exporting: asking the server for the served artifact as {format}…
analytics.export.toast: Saved in the format the server served: {format}
analytics.export.toast_fallback: Saved as a degradation: asked {requested}, served {format} (the panel states why)
analytics.export.result: Served artifact: {filename} (served format {format}, name taken from the server Content-Disposition)
analytics.export.fallback: Degraded: asked {requested}, served {format}. Reason: {reason}. This is not broken and it is not a success; the reason is written on the first screen of the file and in its metadata section.
analytics.export.sha: Fingerprint of this file: {sha} (verify offline that this is the artifact exported at that moment)
analytics.export.sha_missing: This file has no fingerprint header: the server did not send X-TraceLens-Export-Sha256, and the page does not invent one.
analytics.export.bytes: The saved bytes equal the served bytes (the CSV carries the server UTF-8 BOM), so the fingerprint above describes this file.
analytics.export.pdf_direct: A served PDF is binary: the page hands the same URL to the browser so it takes the server bytes. That is a new response, and its fingerprint is the one in that response header.
analytics.export.print: What was served is printable HTML: no external links, no script, styles inline, and the first screen states the degradation reason.
analytics.export.print_open: Open in a new tab (Ctrl+P saves a PDF)
analytics.export.printed: The served printable HTML is open in a new tab.
analytics.export.print_unavailable: This environment has no new-tab capability: the file was saved in the served format, open it in a browser and press Ctrl+P.
analytics.export.denied: This account has no audit.export: the export buttons are collapsed, the dashboard can be read but not shipped out.
analytics.export.offline: Exporting needs the server: this page is offline, and it will not fabricate a file that only looks right.
analytics.export.format_missing: The server sent no X-TraceLens-Export-Format: the page does not know what was served, so it does not say exported.
analytics.export.not_saved: No file was saved in this round: the page reports what it did, not what it intended to do.
analytics.export.plane_echo: Provenance inside the artifact: {value} (this read scanned {scanned} records), so the paper carries where its numbers came from.
